source.title: Banks and Other Financial Institutions Act, 2020
source.extracted_from: Independent visual transcription of arrangement, PDF pages 3–7 (A651–655); 132 distinct raw Vision body section labels on PDF pages 9–85
source.note: As enacted scan. Full offline Apple Vision evidence retained unchanged. Catalogue is a separately labelled image transcription, not repaired OCR. All 132 titles legible; body labels count 132. Raw Vision omits 11 and 92 and reads 11l./13l.; image labels read 11/92/111/131. Duplicate titles 122/126 retained. Does not consolidate later instruments or establish legal currency. One terminal full stop removed in catalogue convention; source alternatives retained.
